description: STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg: road datasets is a collection of datasets listed in The Luxembourg Data Platform, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. Coverage: STATEC Institut national de la statistique et des études économiques du Grand-Duché de Luxembourg. The listing groups 6 datasets under this publisher or service host whose titles are about road; the first few are linked and all are named in the audit file. Examples: Entreprises - Transports - Transport routier - Passagers; Entreprises - Transports - Transport routier; Entreprises - Transports - Transport routier - Infrastructures; Entreprises - Transports - Transport routier - Fret. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is cc-zero, notspecified. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support transport network, traffic and access studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-la-plateforme-de-donnees-luxembourgeoise.
